input.answer: I'd go with A, the coin towers. It's the only one where I got it in two seconds: the fund pile with 66,513 ₪ next to the small securities row with 19,595 ₪, and below it 98,738 ₪ against 23,973 ₪ if you wait until year 6. So yes, the keren hishtalmut is obviously worth it, mostly because of the employer's yellow coins.

stuck.where: Option B, the number line above the chart
stuck.why: "+527 ₪" under "אותו כסף עובר לקרן". I didn't get what those 527 are or why there's barely a step there
A big minus in the middle of the row made me think I'd lose money, until I saw the 66,513 at the end

stuck.where: Option A, the striped coins at the top of the pile
stuck.why: I didn't know what the pink striped coins were until I glanced at the table and saw "מס במשיכה"
No label next to it. I guessed it's the securities account, and only from the line at the bottom about the 300 ₪

used: The big heading "קרן השתלמות: מה הכי מעניין"

Option A: "66,513 ₪" vs "19,595 ₪", and the year-6 drawing "98,738 ₪" vs "23,973 ₪"

The labels "לפני 6 שנים: מס" / "מ-6 שנים: פטור ממס"
The "מומלץ" tag on A
Option B: the row of numbers and the column labels
Option C: the three numbers at the bottom, 66,513 / 18,000 / 19,595
skimmed: The table under the coins (just the "מס במשיכה" row and "נשאר בידיים")
The text under B and under C
skipped: The small orange/grey note under the cards ("דוגמה: שכר ברוטו 12,000...")
The grey lines under the table about the 19 funds and management fees
unsure_meaning: The pink striped coins/bars, which I guessed were tax
The white line in C, which I guessed was the securities account
"רווח אחרי דמי ניהול", the turquoise colour: I never got how big the fees are
The dotted underlines under the numbers: is that a link?

findings.what: A big "−13,974 ₪" sits in the middle of the number row and scares you before you get to the result
"+527 ₪ אותו כסף עובר לקרן" isn't clear, and the step is so thin you can hardly see it
The white line isn't labelled on the chart itself, so you have to guess it's the securities account
The striped coins on top of the pile aren't explained next to the coins, only in the table underneath
A is drawn twice (year 5, then year 6), which makes for a lot of scrolling over the same thing
Lots of empty space above the coins in A before you get to the numbers
The assumptions note is long, small, orange, and nobody reads it
